/**
 * Lightweight event store.
 * Lets HomePage navigate to /result at 99% while the CSV fetch keeps running.
 * ResultPage subscribes on mount; if data is already there it fires immediately.
 */let _pending=null;const _subscribers=[];/** Called by HomePage when the fetch resolves (or rejects with an error). */export function publishResult(data){_pending=data;_subscribers.splice(0).forEach(fn=>fn(data));}/**
 * Called by ResultPage on mount.
 * If data has already arrived the callback fires synchronously and clears the store.
 * Otherwise it is queued until publishResult is called.
 */export function subscribeResult(fn){if(_pending!==null){const d=_pending;_pending=null;fn(d);}else{_subscribers.push(fn);}}/** Called on ResultPage unmount — clears pending data and queued callbacks. */export function cancelResult(){_pending=null;_subscribers.length=0;}
